EmailTemplate.name: MAQL SLA EXPIRED
EmailTemplate.subject: Please log an activity, call or email on your MQL lead.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Lead.OwnerFirstName},
The lead you own {!Lead.Name} from {!Lead.Company} in the MQL Stage, with priority of {!Lead.Core_Lead_Priority__c} must be contacted.
Click here to visit this lead record in SFDC
As a reminder, the following SLA is expected for MQL lead assigned to you:
(<Lead Priority> if Hot): Lead Status must attempt contact within 1 business day. Initial Activity (Email or Phone Call) must be logged the following business day. (<Lead Priority> if Warm): Lead Status must attempt contact within 2 business days. Initial Activity (Email or Phone Call) must be logged the following business day. (<Lead Priority> if Cold): Lead Status must attempt contact within 4 business days. Initial Activity (Email or Phone Call) must be logged the following business day.
Please process your lead by updating the Lead Status and Sub Status as soon as possible. Non processed Leads will be reflected in reporting for Action.
Leads move to a terminated state if there is no activity for 30 days and 90 days since the creation date.
Thank you.
